# Great Southern Bank Indian Hills Grand Reopening


Great Southern Bank invites customers and community members to celebrate the grand reopening of its remodeled Indian Hills banking center, located at 3839 Indian Hills Dr. in Sioux City, Iowa. The event is on Friday, Nov. 20, from 7:30 a.m. to 5 p.m.


"We are here, we are committed, and we are building for the future of this community." — Laura Smith, Chief Retail Banking Officer


Jennifer Russell


## What to Expect


Throughout the day, guests are welcome to tour the remodeled facility, see demonstrations of the new drive-thru Live Teller ATMs, participate in games for a chance to win Great Southern swag and more.


**Event highlights include:**


- Free coffee from the Heartland Coffee & Nosh Truck and Jitters donuts starting at 7:30 a.m. (while supplies last)
- Sioux City Chamber of Commerce ribbon cutting at 10 a.m.
- Custom cookies from Sugar Shack Bakery beginning at 11:30 a.m.
- $1,500 Great Southern Bank Mastercard® gift card drawing — attendees 18 and older are eligible to enter.[*See Official Rules for details.](https://www.greatsouthernbank.com/about/indian-hills-official-rules)


## About the Remodel


The remodeled banking center features a modernized layout and brightened décor. It also includes two new drive-thru Live Teller ATMs, available seven days a week from 7 a.m. to 7 p.m., connecting customers directly with a live Great Southern teller for help with deposits, check cashing, loan payments and more.


Great Southern Bank has served the Sioux City market since 2009. The Indian Hills remodel is the latest in a series of banking center builds and remodels reflecting the bank’s continued commitment to its customers and communities.


We hope to see you Nov. 20! Find our location and hours at[GreatSouthernBank.com/locations](https://www.greatsouthernbank.com/locations) .
